Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
What happens if the Great Beast, or a Shock Troop, gets a Writ of
Acceptance?
He's Clanless and Camarilla, does that make him Caitiff?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No.

Caitiff are clanless and Camarilla.
But not all clanless Camarilla vampires are Caitiff.

Analogy:

Dogs are mammals and have four legs.
